notes: Customers can delete a game's progress from My saves (asked first; the PC gets its own files back), and the Load button is gone since PLAY loads progress before the game opens. Every stored game path is rewritten to use Windows variables like %USERPROFILE%. The staff panel shows Standalone or Server mode, and the Shop server page has a Standalone / Server mode switch in place of Keep reconnecting, showing only the settings for the mode in use.
